Player now records heartbeat outcome, connection transitions, content-fetch source and receipt skip reason to a per-device rolling record. #790 and #791 filed and NOT fixed in this PR; #790 fixed separately in PR #793.

previousCompletedAssignment.assignment: Board-fit safety net for #790, generic above all display layouts
previousCompletedAssignment.acceptance: Independent review (isolated worktree agent) returned MERGE, clean. One non-blocking suggestion (ResizeObserver-absent TV WebViews got zero protection) fixed anyway in 4109b8ea and re-verified live. Merged and deployed at the owner's direct instruction.
previousCompletedAssignment.notes: DisplayFrame measures rendered board height vs actual viewport and scales the whole board down to fit (never up, floor 0.4), instead of a per-layout CSS fix - deliberately, since Theme Studio is still design-stage with nothing built. Verified against the live QA screen's real content: scale 1080/1354=0.7976, all 6 items now visible where 3 were previously off-screen.
